summary: Termite, rodent, insect and wasp control for homes and businesses in League City, Houston and nearby towns in Harris and Galveston County.

groups.title: Termite Control
groups.summary: Termite inspection, liquid treatment or bait stations, backed by our termite warranty.
groups.intro: Termites are not a problem any homeowner wants to face during their lifetime. These wood-chewing pests can cause thousands of dollars in damage to a structure with little or no warning. The Texas Gulf Coast is in the high-risk zone for termites, making their prevention even more important to protect your home investment.

services.title: Termite Inspection
services.text: First, we'll perform a thorough inspection of your home. Then we'll review your options with you and help you make a decision based on our recommendation and your budget.

services.title: Termite Treatment
services.text: We offer two means of termite protection: conventional termite protection with the Termidor HE treatment, or the less invasive Trelona ATBS bait stations. Both programs protect your home against termite damage in different ways.

services.title: Termite Warranty
services.text: We guarantee our termite control services through our termite warranty, which protects your home from possible termite infestation after your initial termite treatment.

groups.title: Rodent Control
groups.summary: Complete, reliable removal of rats and mice, with every entry point found and sealed off.
groups.intro: The most common rodents are the house mouse, Norway rat and roof rat. They spread diseases, contaminate food, damage property and breed quickly. With over 23 years of experience, our team gives you the instant relief you need and the long-term protection you deserve.

services.title: Rodent Inspection
services.text: We start with a thorough inspection in and around your home to identify the species, areas of activity, potential entry points and attractants. Rats and mice need different traps, so this step matters.

services.title: Rodent Sanitation
services.text: After the inspection, we give you detailed sanitation guidelines and a checklist to eliminate attractants and keep a clean, sanitary environment.

services.title: Baits & Traps
services.text: We combine baiting and trapping for the highest rate of success. For a large population we start with a high-quality bait, then place traps in and around the area of activity. Baits and traps are set according to the law, with children and pets kept safe.

services.title: Monitoring
services.text: After we place the baits and set the traps, we return to check the program is working and make adjustments as needed.

services.title: Rodent Exclusion
services.text: Once the existing problem is gone, our exclusion work makes your property a "No Go" for future rodents. Our goal is for your property to be 100% rodent free.
points: Site inspection, plan, baits and traps, monitoring and exclusion work

groups.title: Ant, Roach, Flea & Bed Bug Control
groups.summary: Inspection and treatment for ants, roaches, fleas and bed bugs, inside and out.
groups.intro: Store-bought sprays and over-the-counter remedies often scatter pests around your home instead of getting rid of them. Our team identifies what you're dealing with, treats it at the source and works to keep it from coming back.

services.title: Ant Control
services.text: We inspect carpet edges, doors, windows and your kitchen inside, and foundation walls, vegetation and mulch outside. Inside, professional baits go where ants are active so they carry it back to the queen; outside, we use baits, granules, dusts and liquid sprays to make sure they're gone for good.

services.title: Roach Control
services.text: We first identify which roach you have, then check for sanitation issues. German and other small roaches are treated with baits and insect growth regulators; American, Australian, smokey brown and oriental roaches with a residual insecticide and granular baits.

services.title: Flea Control
services.text: We inspect the whole property, then treat floors indoors and the areas your pets frequent outdoors with a liquid residual and insect growth regulator (IGR), killing fleas at every stage of their life cycle. Two or three services are required to eliminate fleas.

services.title: Bed Bug Control
services.text: We inspect your mattress, box spring, bed frame, headboard, walls and carpet, plus adjoining rooms, and share a preparation checklist. Then we apply a combination of liquid, aerosol and dust to the mattress, baseboards and furniture. We also carry mattress encasements and active guard liners.
points: Two follow-up visits spaced ten days apart recommended
Guaranteed for a minimum of 30 days

groups.title: Wasp Control
groups.summary: Safe removal of hornet, yellow jacket and paper wasp nests, usually within 24 hours.
groups.intro: Wasps build their nests here in spring, and by the end of fall a colony can house up to 150 wasps. We safely remove hornets, yellow jackets, paper wasps and other stinging insects without endangering your family or pets, and we can pre-treat your home to discourage new nests.

services.title: Wasp Nest Inspection
services.text: We check under eaves, in the ground, around bushes and trees and more, to locate every nest and identify the species.

services.title: Nest Knockdown
services.text: We treat your property using our wasp treating techniques so your wasp problem is resolved. We do our best to remove wasp nests from homes in our service area within 24 hours.

services.title: Nest Treatment
services.text: We dust void areas with an insecticide that keeps killing emerging wasps for six months or more where the dust is protected, and spray the surrounding area with a residual liquid to keep new nests from going up.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with my service?
faqs.a: If you aren't satisfied with your most recent service for some reason, we'll keep working until you are. No questions asked. We guarantee it.

faqs.q: Is your rodent control service safe?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our thoroughly trained technicians place baits and set traps according to the law, so your children and pets are kept safe before, during and after service.

faqs.q: How long do I have to wait before going outside after a flea treatment?
faqs.a: Make sure the product is completely dry first. Depending on temperature and humidity, we recommend waiting at least an hour before going back into the treated area.

faqs.q: Do I need to throw away my mattress if I have bed bugs?
faqs.a: It depends on the mattress and the size of the infestation. With holes or tears we usually recommend discarding it. If it's in good shape and the infestation isn't severe, we carry mattress safe encasements and active guard liners.

faqs.q: How do I prevent bed bugs from entering my home?
faqs.a: Inspect any used furniture before bringing it home, especially bed frames, mattresses and couches. Check for bed bugs in your hotel room while traveling, and vacuum your luggage and wash the clothes you took once you get home.

faqs.q: After a wasp nest is removed, will there be activity?
faqs.a: Yes. For roughly 24 hours you'll see foraging wasps return to where the nest was. They may be irritated, so stay away from that area until they're gone.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get rid of roaches?
faqs.a: It depends on the species and how severe the infestation is. Call 281-487-2157 to schedule your free roach inspection and we'll give you an estimate.
